_note: Reference/documentation copy of the character portion of new_campaign_state.json (the file engine.py actually loads for a fresh game). Keep these in sync if you tune starting values.
name: Gaius Julius Caesar

attribute_notes.oration: A genuinely strong public speaker, though not yet in Cicero's class - his real gift with a crowd shows more in Presence.
attribute_notes.intellect: Sharp, strategic, and already a serious political operator by 59 BCE, well before the Commentaries make it famous in writing.
attribute_notes.resolve: Solid but not yet the legendary nerve of the Gallic and civil war years - this is a level-1 sheet, and Gaul hasn't happened yet.
attribute_notes.presence: His real weapon - the popularis touch that makes popular_support so high even as senate_standing lags.
attribute_notes.cunning: Extraordinary political maneuvering, embodied in the Triumvirate itself.
attribute_notes.physique: Fit and a capable rider/campaigner, but proven military genius is still ahead of him - Hispania was real, Gaul is the growth arc.

note_on_growth: Starts at the height of the First Triumvirate's power but before Gaul, before civil war, before the Rubicon - the growth arc is less 'become important' (he already is) and more 'convert this fragile political position into an unshakeable one,' with military_glory and treasury the resources most obviously set up to move if the campaign follows Caesar toward Gaul.
